== Brother of Matt Sokol (2026-10-26) ==
Two DeckTech tournament reports from 5 November 2000 say Dan Sokol is [[Matt Sokol]]'s brother:
* Mike Panayotou, syracuse-ny-11-4-00 (d1418): "I am paired with Dan Sokol (Matt’s brother)". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026030847/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-05-syracuse-ny-11-4-00d1418/ Internet Archive].
* Brian Terwilliger, twigg-takes-the-coruscant-civil-war-2 (d1417): "World Champ Matt Sokol, his bro, Dan (great player!)". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026030732/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-05-twigg-takes-the-coruscant-civil-war-2d1417/ Internet Archive].
A 2001 DeckTech report (a-weekend-with-kyle-craft, d2536) also has "Matt Sokol. He comes over with his bro Dan". The [[Trandosite]] Matt Sokol interview (iv16) does not mention him.

== DecipherCon 1999 photo identification (27 October 2026) ==
[[Matt Sokol]] identified his brother Dan Sokol as the man in the yellow shirt on the right (third from left, no cap) in [[:File:Team Albany DecipherCon 1999.jpg]] (personal communication to Bill Bisco, 27 October 2026). Lead crop: [[:File:Dan Sokol DecipherCon 1999.jpg]]. The group photo is in Photographs.

== Team Albany membership (27 October 2026) ==
Dan Sokol is listed as a [[Team Albany]] member on Bill Bisco's ruling (27 October 2026). The basis is the yellow Team Albany shirt he wears in Decipher's DecipherCon 1999 photo thu16 ([[:File:Team Albany DecipherCon 1999.jpg]]), plus [[Matt Sokol]]'s identification of him in that photo (personal communication to Bill Bisco, 27 October 2026). No published roster names him.
